Multi-turn conversation with system, user, assistant, and follow-up user messages

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "You are a helpful assistant.", "role" => "system"], ["content" => "What is 2 + 2?", "role" => "user"], ["content" => "2 + 2 equals 4.", "role" => "assistant"], ["content" => "And what is 4 + 4?", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4"]));
$result = LiterLlm::chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getContent());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
```
